items.title: Model Release Notes
items.brief_summary: We’ve made a few updates to the Model Spec , a living document that outlines intended behavior for OpenAI’s models, to better reflect how our systems are evolving. The changes focus on strengthening clarity and guardrails as our models move beyond chat into more agentic use cases, refining authority levels and priorities, expanding guidance on personalities and safety, and incorporating public feedback.
